title: Football match predictions: pre-match 1X2 probabilities and results
description:
Every settled prediction of the Football Analytics model (footballanalytics.pro): for each finished match in the covered competitions, the 1X2 probabilities a Dixon-Coles / Poisson model stored before kick-off, its goal expectations, its pick and the final score. Nothing is filtered by outcome.

One row per match in CSV; one file for all competitions and one per competition. The repository is refreshed daily from the canonical source, https://footballanalytics.pro/data, and its commit history records the rows as they were added.
